name: agentex
description: AgenTeX: 18 skills + 2 hooks that keep LaTeX papers honest to the code behind them: verified citations with a cite guard, results-to-macros sync with stale-number audits, a compile-and-fix loop, TikZ, equations, tables, prior-work search, overlap screening, mock peer review and arXiv packaging. Plus 24 templates beyond the paper (posters, CVs, theses, exams, letters, cheat sheets), Markdown/Word/PDF-to-LaTeX conversion, mail merge and PDF finishing (PDF/A, forms, compression).

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Show the AgenTeX band above the prompt: a one-time welcome after install and a small animation while AgenTeX checks run.
